draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds) in T1. There are no noise-perturbation experiments, no T2, and no drop values (0.6, 1.3, 1.8). The writer's cited IDs (T2.r1.th_drop etc.) do not exist in the package. The claim is entirely unsupported.
